syllabus_title: Physics Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education

content.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of the concepts, principles and processes of Physics
content.specific_competence: 1.1 Describe the fundamental concepts of Physics

learning_activities.activity: (a) Explain the basic concepts of Physics (meaning, branches, importance and its relationship with other disciplines)
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss meaning of physics, basic terminologies and branches of physics
Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on importance of physics in our daily life
Jigsaw: Guide students in manageable groups to explain the relationship of Physics with other disciplines through jigsaw
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The basic concept of Physics are clearly explained
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Charts, relevant text, and online resources on basic concept of physics

learning_activities.activity: (b) Describe measurement in Physics (units, instruments, and accuracy)
teaching_learning_methods: Group Discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss concept of measurement
ICT-Based learning: Guide students to explain measurement units and instruments through simulation
Experimentation: Guide students to measure various physical quantities using appropriate instruments
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: The concept of measurement is described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Measuring instruments, charts/models, and online resources on measurement

learning_activities.activity: (c) Describe motion (distance, displacement, speed, velocity, and acceleration)
teaching_learning_methods: Field visit: Guide students to observe different types of motion in their environment
Group Discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the concepts of motion
ICT-Based learning: Guide students to explain motion concepts through simulation
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Motion charts/models, relevant equipment, and online resources on motion

content.main_competence: 2.0 Apply Physics concepts to solve problems
content.specific_competence: 2.1 Solve problems involving motion and forces

teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students to discuss types of forces and their effects
Experimentation: Guide students to demonstrate effects of forces
ICT-Based learning: Guide students to visualize forces through simulation
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Forces and their effects are described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Force demonstration equipment, charts, and online resources

teaching_learning_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on different forms of energy
Group Discussion: Guide students to discuss energy transformation
Project: Guide students to identify energy forms in their environment
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Energy and its forms are described clearly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Energy demonstration equipment, charts, and online resources

content.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate mastery of basic skills for conducting Physics investigations

learning_activities.activity: (a) Describe the basic skills for conducting Physics experiments
teaching_learning_methods: Group discussion: Guide students to visit physics laboratory to identify common apparatus and equipment
Experimentation: Guide students to perform activities that involve observation and measurement
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Basic skills for conducting Physics experiments are correctly described
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Physics laboratory equipment, online resources on experimental skills

learning_activities.activity: (b) Carry out investigations related to motion and forces
teaching_learning_methods: Experimentation: Guide students to carry out investigations on motion and forces
learning_activities.assessment_criteria: Investigations related to motion and forces are carried out correctly
learning_activities.suggested_resources: Variety of equipment and apparatus, online resources on motion and forces
